summary: Inline nested loops now have unique history subjects based on their owning step paths, so same-named loops no longer share round results or feedback

replay.detail: Existing claims are not rewritten. New nested-loop revisions derive distinct loop history subjects.

schema.detail: No claim kind, field or subject pattern changes.

compatibility.detail: Publication hashes change for missions containing inline nested loops on the next source apply or sync. Upgrade all publishers first: mixed old/new publishers can alternate the current revision. Top-level loop hashes and subjects are unchanged. Runs in progress keep their pinned revision and old history subjects, including existing collisions, until deliberate cutover; no history repair is performed.

manual.detail: Nested owning paths containing @ or .., control characters, or feedback/outcome names exceeding 512 bytes now fail source apply explicitly, preserving the previous published revision. Rename unsafe nested owners before applying.

recovery.detail: Downgrade or revert preserves pinned revisions: new revisions store raw owning paths valid for the unchanged legacy document writers, not an encoded namespace.
